description: Read the full holdmark record for one store, by its domain. Figures are rounded against the merchant, order volume is published in bands rather than exact numbers, and every figure carries the period it covers and the source it came from. A fact with no data answers "not_measured" with its reason, never "no". If the domain is not in the registry you get a plain answer saying so, which is not a verdict about that store.

domain.description: The store's domain, for example tienda.com. Without https:// and without www.

name: get_store
title: Read one store's record
